header_rows: Key Points•Higher antibacterial activity and lower hemolysis of ID13 than DLP4.•ID13 could downregulate the genes of bacterial survival and infection.•ID13 could alleviate the S. aureus-induced endometritis of mice.•ID13 could regulate the cytokines and suppress the TLR2-NF-κB signal pathway.
